current_parent_pointer: atomic pointer to certificate SHA only; not scientific authority by itself
history_copy_policy: Do not nest previous full bundles into every level. Reference immutable store objects by SHA and include only required forward-parent material.

per_level_outputs.forward_parent_capsule: mandatory; includes selected relation, baseline, classification, parent certificate, plan/question/protocol/evidence pins and required small verification evidence
per_level_outputs.full_standalone_run_release: mandatory at a scientific trigger, chain limit, chain closeout, source change or publication checkpoint; optional for routine intermediate levels
